standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145249Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after two fixes (block-less-CME nearest-week pairing; ams_dmn_cheese declared accumulates). The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-11-02 by a session from numbers.md, then revised on an independent review that recalculated every headline figure from the captured reports (all matched) and required two changes: the CME block weekly average rose in both October weeks the record holds (1.294, 1.348, 1.5395), not in one, and the 500-pound barrel's 1.9495 for the week ending 2025-05-31 is a first print that the report of 2025-06-11 restated null with the three weeks before it. Seven clarifications were applied (no support in the captures for 'immediate loads' or 'a few loads'; the block close named as blocks; the 7 CFR 1170 referral; the participant wording quoted; the revised week ending 2026-09-26 noted without its first-published figure, which is not in the computed set). tools/check.py passes. The editor read and signed the result on 2026-11-02. This is the first issue of this title; its September 2026 baseline does not publish (owner decision 2026-10-25). Known limits stated in the text: the CME series has no year-over-year until the record covers a year, around September 2027; the four-week CME averages are 1.3815 blocks and 1.4668 barrels (simple averages of weekly averages); the 2026-10-16 Dairy Market News report prints a second, different weekly average in its page 2 table and the record reads page 1, which equals the simple average of the five daily closes; the barrel series is history, not a current price, and the retained file does not say whether cheese_500_Price is moisture-adjusted (the reviewer found cheese_500_Wtd_Price equals cheese_500_Price x 62/(100 - moisture) in 3,425 of 3,440 priced rows, which fits the column read being unadjusted; not stated in the issue). For the editor: issue.py's series map skips null rows, so it keeps the barrel's first print rather than the later null restatement; under the latest-restatement rule the last week still carrying a price is 2025-05-03. The next-issue date, November 13, 2026, matches the pork and egg-butter issues and is not in any capture. The verification gate reads no bare count or worded quantity: 17 entities, 63 entities, five weeks, the four-week paths and the counts of reports and runs were checked by hand against the captures. Publication is gated only by FA-D-20261018-01: one title at a time, through the review step.
